en.r: Mississippi Headwaters State Forest is a state forest in Minnesota, United States.
en.h: A state forest near Wilton in Beltrami County, Minnesota, extending into Clearwater and Hubbard counties. It is named for lying just downstream of Lake Itasca, the headwaters of the Mississippi River. Hills and outwash plains left by the Wisconsinan glaciation shape the land; the state natural resources department manages about 9,000 acres (3,600 ha).
en.ff: Sandy moraines are dominated by eastern white pine, red pine, oaks, maples, birch and aspen; black spruce, northern white cedar and tamarack grow on wet peat soils.

es.r: El Mississippi Headwaters State Forest es un bosque estatal en Minnesota, Estados Unidos.

Lleva el nombre por estar justo aguas abajo del lago Itasca, la naciente del río Misisipi. en.r: Old Mill State Park is a state park in Minnesota, United States. It covers 1.2 km² and has been protected since 1937. It is managed by the state government.

The state bought it in 1937 and rebuilt the steam engine in 1958; the mill still runs for demonstrations.

en.h: A Minnesota state park established in 1961 to preserve the historic Savanna Portage, a difficult 9.7 km trail linking the Mississippi River and Lake Superior watersheds. It lies 27 km northeast of McGregor and 80 km west of Duluth.

pt.r: A Rum River State Forest é uma floresta estadual em Minnesota, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 85,5 km² e está sob gestão do governo estadual.
pt.h: Floresta estadual no centro de Minnesota, nos condados de Kanabec, Mille Lacs e Morrison, perto de Onamia, no rio Rum logo abaixo do lago Mille Lacs. A mata original foi cortada e levada pelos rios às serrarias; fazendas falidas nos anos 1930 voltaram a ser floresta.
pt.ff: Folhosas do norte (bordos, carvalhos, freixos, olmos e tílias) nas partes altas; lariços e abetos-negros nas baixadas e pântanos.

en.r: Rum River State Forest is a state forest in Minnesota, United States. It covers 85.5 km² and is managed by the state government.
en.h: A state forest in central Minnesota, in Kanabec, Mille Lacs and Morrison counties, near Onamia, on the Rum River just below Mille Lacs Lake. The original forest was cut and floated to downstream mills; farms that failed in the 1930s returned to forest.
en.ff: Northern hardwoods (maple, oak, ash, elm and basswood) on the uplands; tamarack and black spruce in lowlands and marshes.

es.r: El Rum River State Forest es un bosque estatal en Minnesota, Estados Unidos. Tiene 85,5 km² y está bajo la gestión del gobierno estatal.
es.h: Bosque estatal en el centro de Minnesota, en los condados de Kanabec, Mille Lacs y Morrison, cerca de Onamia, en el río Rum justo debajo del lago Mille Lacs. El bosque original se taló y se llevó por los ríos a los aserraderos; granjas quebradas en los años 1930 volvieron a ser bosque.
es.ff: Frondosas del norte (arces, robles, fresnos, olmos y tilos) en las partes altas; alerces y píceas negras en las zonas bajas y pantanos.
